rationale: The user explicitly favors the existing Swiss/Editorial aesthetic from the /showcase page. For an academic and authoritative SEO play (SWU Marketing), an editorial 'digital magazine' approach establishes E-E-A-T (Expertise, Authoritativeness, Trustworthiness) better than generic SaaS gradients.

fonts.heading: 'IBM Plex Serif', 'IBM Plex Serif Thai', serif
fonts.body: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'IBM Plex Sans Thai', sans-serif

typography.pairing_rules: Use IBM Plex Serif for all main headings to create a scholarly/editorial feel. Use IBM Plex Mono for overlines, metadata, and tags. Use IBM Plex Sans for long-form readability.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Asymmetrical, grid-based, heavy use of negative space. 'Paper' feel with 1px hairline borders delineating sections.

grid.bento_marketing: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-px bg-hairline border-y border-hairline
grid.article_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8 md:gap-12

hero_showcase.layout: Full viewport height or min-h-[85vh]. Split or overlapping grid. Massive serif typography intersecting with scrolling brand cards.
hero_showcase.interactions: Lenis smooth scroll mandatory. On scroll, brand research cards float upwards with slight parallax. Hover on brand cards reveals SWU scoring badges.
hero_showcase.visuals: Paper background, large 'PUBLIC SHOWCASE' mono eyebrow. 1px solid black border at the bottom.

tools_grid.layout: Bento box style, utilizing 1px borders to separate cells instead of gaps (CSS: gap-px with a gray background on the container).
tools_grid.hover: Hovering a cell changes its background from paper to pure white or subtle red tint, with an arrow icon translating right.
tools_grid.content: Links to Conjoint Analysis, Journey Mapping, Survey Builder, etc.

article_card.layout: Editorial block. No rounded corners. Top border (1px solid black). Mono date/category, large serif title, concise sans excerpt.
article_card.image: Grayscale or highly contrasted image, optionally overlapping the border.

content_layout.template: Left sidebar (sticky TOC & share links, col-span-3) + Main content (col-span-6) + Right sidebar (Tool CTAs / Author, col-span-3).
content_layout.typography: Drop caps for the first paragraph. Pull quotes using massive left border (SWU Red) and italic serif.

inline_tool_cta.layout: Inserted mid-article. High contrast block (Black background, white text) to break the paper texture and grab attention.
inline_tool_cta.action: Direct link to the related tool.

hero_background.description: Subtle paper texture for hero background or large section backgrounds.

university_campus.description: Modern university building with trees. Use for the 'About SWU Marketing' pillar page hero.

marketing_strategy.description: White paper with Marketing Strategy text. Use for article thumbnails or Knowledge Hub index.

brand_identity.description: Man holding a book about designing brand identity. Use for Brand Equity article thumbnail.

media.image_treatment: All photos should have a slightly desaturated or high-contrast pass (via CSS filter: grayscale(20%) contrast(110%)) to fit the editorial vibe. NO heavy rounded corners (max rounded-sm or sharp edges).

seo_and_accessibility.heading_hierarchy: Strict H1 > H2 > H3. Ensure the Knowledge Hub uses semantic HTML5 <article> and <aside> tags.
seo_and_accessibility.json_ld: Must include Article schema on /learn/[topic] pages and BreadcrumbList schema.
seo_and_accessibility.performance: No heavy WebGL. Use CSS for interactions (transforms, opacity) to ensure Core Web Vitals remain in the green for SEO ranking.
seo_and_accessibility.test_ids: Add data-testid to all links, tools, and TOC elements (e.g., data-testid='toc-link', data-testid='hero-showcase-link').

instructions_to_main_agent: Migrate the homepage from the old gradient SaaS look to the '.be-root' Swiss/Editorial aesthetic (Background: #F7F4EE, Text: #1A1A1A).
Implement the Hero section featuring the Brand Showcase. Fetch data from GET /api/brand-equity/showcase if possible, or mock it beautifully using the editorial grid.
Build the Tools Showcase Grid below the hero using a 1px border grid layout (bento style).
Create the /learn Knowledge Hub index page showcasing articles in an editorial, masonry or strict grid layout.
Create the /learn/[topic] article template with a sticky left TOC, main content area, and right sidebar for Tool CTAs. Use IBM Plex Serif for headings.
Create the /about/swu-marketing pillar page focusing on E-E-A-T. Use the provided university campus image.
Ensure all components use proper semantic tags and include SEO-friendly structures.
